title: Magnetite-functionalized eggshell membrane composite: a high-performance magnetic adsorbent for Congo red dye
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,25197-25207
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01484D, Paper

Faheem Shah
This study develops a sustainable magnetic adsorbent, Fe3O4@ESM, by embedding magnetite nanoparticles onto an avian eggshell membrane (ESM) matrix for the efficient remediation of Congo red (CR) from wastewater. Graphical abstract image created with the assistance of Google Gemini.
